notes.title: A new DLC and a free update are coming this fall!
notes.notes:
To celebrate the biggest sale yet, we have a few good news to announce! 

The first and the most exciting is that we are working on a FREE update and a new DLC! Both are coming out this fall! To name a few things that we plan to add to the game: 

 New floor with 11 new levels! 
 New powerup! 
 Two new modifiers. 
 A few long-awaited fixes. (you know what I'm talking about ;)) 
 New "League system".

We have one more awesome surprise, but more on that in August! 

Btw, we are also working on a really cool project called Escape Simulator. Check it out, and don't forget to wishlist! <3 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435790/Escape_Simulator/?utm_source=seum&utm_campaign=landing 

To new speedrunners: have fun! \m/
Pine Studio team

notes.title: Season 8 update and super hot discounts!
notes.notes:
Dear Speedrunners, 

It’ll be a cold day in Hell before we run out of new seasons! Season 8 is now officially open, so set your sights on the top of the leaderboard and don’t settle for anything less.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24329565/30a3fefff6f64e953ed95141207f555274814199.png
To make sure that awesome news comes in pairs, we’re happy to share that SEUM is currently 70% off (biggest discount yet!!), while “Drunk Side of the Moon” and the brain-melting soundtrack are also at 60% of their usual price.

Grab ‘em while they’re HOT! \m/

We’re also working on an update with some long-awaited fixes which got a little delayed because of the release of our newest title “The Academy”. We expect it to be ready in a month’s time, along with a new season maybe...

We hope you’re all safe and well, hit us with your best speedruns and awesome feedback! 

Stay fast,  \m/
Pine Team

notes.title: SEUM Patch #3249
notes.notes:
Here is the full changelog:

Bugs fixed:
* Can't jump from spawnpoint anymore
* Snapback when spawning
* Wrong leaderboard labels on speedrun end screens
* Can't pick up something secret on Mac level select
* Burnt Waffle invincible bug
* Fixed levels which could not have been beaten in speedruns with mutators
* Removed floors that don't exist in DLC from UI
* Cutscenes and decorative torches on walls no longer ignore audio settings
* Incorrect level numbers for locked levels requirement
* 666% can now be achieved if DLC is not bought
* D16 - Ghost platforms in shadow world can be shot from normal world by using roar in the previous level
* Added more bugs to fix later

Leaderboards that will be reset:
* Burnt Waffle
* Spirit Protector
* Parachute
* Faaaaal
* Waffle
* Burnt Waffle
* Hill
* Bunny Hopping
* Lab Rat
* Dolphin Dance

\m/
Pine Studio

notes.title: DLC is out now! + Free Update!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24329565/db2684e472bf8a2662b911cf26512aabad3e8545.gif
Hi, Speedrunners! 
Today we are proud to announce "The Drunk Side of the Moon", the first DLC Expansion for SEUM. It brings a ton of new content to the original game including 3 new powerups, 33 new levels, and new speedrun mutators! 
https://youtu.be/6G7KptTt1dw
What's on the Drunk side of the Moon? 

    Roar
(New Powerup!): Point and fly, super-fast way to fly through levels. It feels like guiding a Redeemer on steroids.
    Rocket
(New Powerup!): Now you can rocket jump, and it’s fun. But we haven’t stopped there! You can actually jump on the rocket and ride it! Going too slow? No problem shoot the rocket with a fireball to give it an extra boost.
    Shadow World 
(New Powerup!): Explore specially crafted levels from the two viewpoints: the world of light and the world of shadows.
Speedrun mutators
Speedrun mode now has mutators which allow you to play speedrun mode by having a powerup of your choosing when you start the level. Replay the old levels with completely new strategies.


We also just released the new game update which marks the beginning of the Season 4. 
To celebrate, the game will be 66.6% off from tomorrow (21st Oct), and you can get the new DLC Expansion now for just 5 bucks! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/457210
Hope you'll like the new content.  
Happy speedrunning! \m/ 

-Pine Studio

notes.title: Season 3 Update Fix and Community Level of the Week!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24329565/5d05edd838ca2565a7061602d3b5505d14c0c122.png

We just pushed a small update to Season 3 which includes small bug fixes:

 Pit of Infamy now shows correct scores past 10th place.
 Fixed issue with replays sometimes not showing.
 You can't finish Spider through secret portal anymore.
 You can erase your split times in Speedrun Mode by clicking on "Speedrun Mode" title 20 times (message will pop up).


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24329565/573f2e95212ed958a234bdeddb3b89f71e013193.png

There are already more than 600 community made levels! So we decided to hand pick one awesome level every week. 

The first Community Level of the Week is War Pigs made by GlidersGames! Try it out and let us know what you think!

SEUM is 50% off for three more days! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/457210/
-PineStudio

notes.notes:

Speedrunners,
SEUM is ready for the new update and new speedrunning season! Are you?

    Fresh Start 
The new season starts by resetting all leaderboard scores. As in the last season, the best players will get their place in the "Pit of Infamy" and will be remembered until the end of times.
    Extended play 2
A free map pack with 11 new levels featuring "Nitro" pickup.
    Glitches and bugs 
We fixed all significant glitches and bugs that were used to get better leaderboard times.
You are going to have to learn the legit route, and we can't wait to watch you struggle! >:)

As always the update is free and to celebrate the beginning of Season 3 the game is available at 50% off, our lowest Steam price yet!

It's a good time to return to Hell!

Pine Studio

notes.title: SEUM update #03
notes.notes:
Focus of this update is still mostly bug fixes. But, we also included a little gift for you in the "Extras" section! ;)

Speedrun mode:

     Displaying correct time differences from the best run
     Fixed problem with falling in level 82
     Fixed an issue with extra time appearing on timer
     Fixed an issue with needing to go through gate multiple times when failing to collect a beer
     You can show leaderboards by pressing TAB

Endless mode:

     You can't fall endlessly anymore
     You can now shoot through power-taking forcefield

Misc:

 Added multiple missing sounds
 You should see your saved progress even in odd situations with bad Steam login
 Added a cover image for soundtrack
 Fov slider can now go higher than 90
 Added ability to change which screen the game is displayed on
 Updated to new version of Unity engine 5.4.0p1

notes.title: SEUM update #02
notes.notes:
We've added a new stats page in "Extras" section of the main menu which shows the total progress of the game, including all bonuses.
 
We fixed a few things in the game as well: 

 Made score uploading more robust
 Full game speedrun now unlocks
 All achievements should now work correctly (666%, Beat a friend, Hardcore Runner)

Happy SEUMing!

notes.title: SEUM update #01
notes.notes:
The devs are listening and we are more than happy that you are not reporting too many bugs! :)
We fixed a few things in the game: 

 Fixed timings on some levels
 Added support for binding more mouse buttons
 Fixed problems with control bindings resetting
 Fixed endless mode shooting bug
 Fixed restart bug in hardcore speedrun mode

SEUM Demo was still in beta version and today we updated it to the current state of the game. Check it out and try 11 levels for free!
